item.feastcraft_arsenal.spear.descriptio: Jabs at reach. Hold right-click to lower it and charge: anything it meets takes damage from how fast you're closing.
modifier.feastcraft_arsenal.charge.descr: Hold right-click to lower the spear. Damage grows with how fast you and your target close, and a fresh charge knocks riders off their mounts.
modifier.feastcraft_arsenal.lunge.descri: Each jab throws you forward, at the cost of hunger and durability. Doesn't work while riding, gliding, swimming or hungry.
